description: This file contains the definition of options and validation logic for configuring an Azure Blob-based lease provider in Orleans. It includes the class 'AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions' which provides configuration properties and methods for creating and setting up a BlobServiceClient, as well as a validator class 'AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptionsValidator' to ensure options are correctly configured.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for an Azure Blob Storage lease provider, including client setup and factory methods.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validator class for ensuring 'AzureBlobLeaseProviderOptions' instances are correctly configured.

methods.name: ConfigureBlobServiceClient
methods.description: Methods to configure the BlobServiceClient using connection string, URI, credentials, or callback.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Method of the validator class to check if the options are valid, including container name and client creation.
